sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No. 4441 of 2019
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, in FIR No.251 of 2017 on the file of Station House Officer, I Town Police Station, Chirala, Prakasam District.

entities.text: I Town Police Station, Chirala, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 273, 188 of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.251 of 2017 on the file of Station House Officer, I Town Police Station, Chirala, Prakasam District for the offences under Sections 273,
188 of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
